av-8b.title: File:Sanborn and Fox in simulator.JPEG
av-8b.author: Lance Corporal Sheila M. Brooks, United States Marine Corps
av-8b.use: Visual study for original polygonal geometry. No source pixels shipped.
av-8b.match: AV-8B Harrier II Plus simulator: keypad unit, HUD controls and right display compared. Consoles and nozzle lever not shown. Also studied (copyright, not shipped): Spanish Navy AV-8B+ cockpit photos on Flickr (Bartolomé Jordán Gómez; Thiago Isvamsinsk; alandalus.airlines) for the left display strip, armament panel and lower-left panel. The left and right consoles, pedestal and throttle/nozzle quadrant follow the NATOPS Flight Manual A1-AV8BB-NFM-000 (2008, archive.org) foldout FO-2 and figure 2-6, with colours and shapes from the RAZBAM DCS AV-8B guides (copyright, studied only). No AV-8B console photograph was found; the Harrier II GR9 cockpit photograph 'Harrier Pilot Prepares for Takeoff MOD 45151641' (OGL v1.0, studied only) shows the forward ends of both consoles in the same cockpit family and was matched: left sill clock and LANDING plate (its seven checks), H2O and flap panels, gear lights and throttle; right sill TAKEOFF plate, caution grille and electrical panel; a white ring fitting on each wall aft of the plates. Aft of those stations the photograph shows only the pilot's legs, kneeboard and canopy frame, so the aft console panels rest on FO-2 alone.
